correctness.rationale: Green (2008) Theorems 3.3.2 and 4.1.2 establish intact free H3. The written proof checks full simple connectivity, the two-clique/matching edge link, integral four-coordinate cross-polytope generators mapping onto a basis of relative H3, split exactness, Van Kampen, and Whitehead. Reproduced full mod-two face ranks for n=4,5,6 agree. Finite tests are not used to prove infinity.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The strongest directly applicable known theorem is the intact-complex integral homology computation. It does not supply the edge-relative connecting map, whose integral surjectivity is essential and established here using cross-polytope boundaries. Full-cube results operate on twice as many vertices and no graph bond deletion.

value.rationale: The result determines an all-parameter, non-equivariant integral homotopy response and primitive inclusion map to a natural one-bond failure in a canonical symmetric flag/Rips family, with explicit local cycles controlling global rank. The link calculation alone does not force this map, so the rank-loss law is not a routine Euler characteristic deduction.
